aboutpara: I am a Computer Engineer and Software Developer with a background in Business Management and extensive professional experience across education, retail, hospitality, and public administration. My diverse background has helped me develop strong technical, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. I have experience developing web applications, backend systems, console applications, and embedded systems projects. Through my role as a Teaching Assistant at the University of Agder, I support students in mathematics, statistics, algorithms, and discrete mathematics, helping them strengthen their understanding of complex concepts and improve their problem-solving abilities. My combination of technical expertise, business knowledge, and practical work experience allows me to approach challenges from both technical and strategic perspectives. I am passionate about software development, continuous learning, and building solutions that create real value for users and organizations.
